latest.title: Nursing-home arrests more often shockable, linked to early AED
latest.finding: Initial shockable rhythm: 36.3% in nursing homes vs 7.1% at home (aOR 12.35, 95% CI 8.93–17.24) and 33.4% in other locations; 97.0% of shockable nursing-home cases got an AED shock; one-month favourable neurological survival lowest in nursing homes at 0.8%

latest.title: Bystanders describe heavy emotional toll of doing CPR
latest.finding: Four themes: emotional impact; managing multiple roles; compelled to help but unprepared; talking to the right person

latest.title: NZ paramedics breached patient rights more often than nurses
latest.finding: Per 1,000 practitioners, paramedics were three times more likely than nurses to breach the Code and breached at a higher severity rate; Right 4 was the most prevalent breach in both professions

latest.title: Drone triage feasible but unproven in real MCIs
latest.finding: Remote capture of heart rate, respiratory rate, temperature, SpO2, consciousness and location is feasible; the single randomised comparison showed UAV-assisted triage took ~3.5 min longer with identical accuracy; no validated remote triage standard exists
